thread:
rachel: Quick PR opened to update the model catalog entry for strait4b. Main changes: note multi-GPU sharding support, clarify embedding tensor layout differences for the repo, add p50/p95 bench numbers, include a short Go SDK snippet for explicit shard routing, and fix a broken bench anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420
pri: Nice. What exactly are the embedding layout differences?
rachel: Short note: strait4b-int8 produces embeddings with channel-last packing for memory efficiency; customers using older sharding clients should set `layout="channels_last"` when decoding. Filed a tiny compatibility blurb.
ben: Runtime also asked we add a line about sharded inference: when using 2+ GPUs we recommend enabling `prefetch_kv=true` to avoid stall at step 0. Can you add that to the performance tips?
rachel: Added to the limits/perf tips table. Also included recommended batch window for long contexts: 60ms on V100/80 for sequences >6k.
console-ui: Request from UI: include a catalog YAML flag `supports_sharding: true` and `variant_ui_label` for per-variant display. We'll read those.
rachel: Added YAML snippet in the PR: `variants:
  - name: strait4b-fp32
    ui_label: "fp32"
  - name: strait4b-int8
    ui_label: "int8"
    fallback: true`
support: Good call to add the embedding layout note. Can you also file an internal support KB entry so CS knows to tell customers to set layout param?
rachel: Filed support note: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/strait4b-embed-layout. Included example CLI and curl snippets.
ben: Could we add a small Go snippet showing how to pick the shard/variant explicitly? Helpful for platform customers.
rachel: Added this Go snippet in the PR comment:
```go
// prefer fp32 variant and route to primary shard when possible
req := GenerateRequest{
  Model: "strait4b",
  Variant: "strait4b-fp32",
  FallbackVariants: []string{"strait4b-int8"},
  ShardHint: "primary", // prefer first shard
  Input: "Summarize the deployment notes.",
  MaxTokens: 300,
}
res, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(res.Output[0].Content)
```
docs-ci-bot: check failed  linkcheck: missing anchor `/bench#strait4b` on bench page.
pri: I'll add a tiny heading to the bench page to provide the anchor, won't change the TOC.
docs-ci-bot: all checks green on PR 1420 (linkcheck, lint, spell).
ben: Any p50/p95 numbers? Sales asked for a one-liner they can paste quickly.
rachel: Added p50=140ms, p95=355ms (A100, internal bench link included). Also added a one-sentence migration note: "If you relied on prior embedding byte order, please update to `channels_last` when decoding strait4b-int8 embeddings."
support: Thanks — will add KB entry to customer-facing docs and flag common troubleshooting steps.
pri: LGTM, approving.
rachel: Merging after CI. Backport queued for the v2 docs site. :tada:
ben: :thumbsup:
rachel: thread closed after merge.
